notes: The chain מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי חָרָשׁ carries no article morpheme at any level, so each of the ASV's three 'the's is a supplied one on its own noun (rule 29); by contrast חֻקּוֹת הָעַמִּים has a present article, which takes the 'the' standing before 'peoples'.

הוּא is unrepresented: the ASV writes no separate subject pronoun and the copula 'are' belongs to the predicate הֶבֶל (rule 20). The indefinite subject 'one' of 'one cutteth' is a pronoun realizing the verb's third-person subject, not a supplied lexical subject noun, so it stays with the verb under rule 17.
